FIELD INCIDENT REPORT
Form FIR-1 (rev. 2026-03)
OPERATOR
Aspen Ridge Pipelines Inc.
REPORTED BY
Control-room operator
RECEIVED VIA
Phone call (on-call write-up)
DESCRIPTION OF THE EVENT (what happened, when, where, who, what was released)
Got a call from the Kerrobert construction site near our pipeline. They hit something and one of
their workers is in the hospital with a broken femur. The site rep said it happened at 16:15 on
May 7. They didn't hit our pipe directly, and we're not leaking anything. The rep assured me that
there's been no release from our pipeline. I'm still on the line with them trying to get more
details. So far, it sounds like it was just a close call. I'll keep you posted if I hear more.
- Jamie, CRO
SUPERVISOR REVIEW
